answers.purpose: Create and read JIRA tickets from the workspace via the standalone curl+jq scripts in tools/jira/: single-key or JQL batch fetch with a flat JSON projection, ticket creation with type/priority/labels/parent, and an auth pre-flight.

triggers.disambiguation: Distinct from confluence-publish (Atlassian Confluence pages, not JIRA issues) and from the built-in /init (CLAUDE.md scaffolding). Owns JIRA issue creation and reading only - not updates, transitions or comments.
